value.rationale: Reciprocal-pair count and the total physical length of reciprocal connections are two natural spatial-clustering statistics. Their exact finite covariance and strictly positive nonzero limiting correlation permit joint calibration and establish a nontrivial geometric fluctuation link not available from the separate marginals.
